source.title: Lottery-like preferences and the MAX effect in the cryptocurrency market
source.authors: Melisa Ozdamar; Levent Akdeniz; Ahmet Sensoy

hypothesis: Cryptocurrencies with larger extreme positive daily returns during the prior month earn higher subsequent weekly returns.
mechanism: Lottery-like demand for extreme positive payoffs is positively priced in crypto; the published weekly cross-section reports higher subsequent returns for high-MAX coins.
signal: Maximum completed UTC daily close-to-close return over the lookback. At Monday 00:00 UTC, daily returns end at prior-day 23:00 closes, so no current-bar information enters the signal.
universe: Point-in-time assets with sufficient exact hourly history and top 80 percent by lagged trailing 30-day close*volume; minimum 8 assets.
rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC; execute at current open.
construction: Equal-weight long highest-MAX quartile / short lowest-MAX quartile, 0.5 gross per side.
development_gate: Canonical mean rank IC >= 0.02, HAC p < 0.05, positive high-minus-low subsequent-week return, at least 100 weekly observations.
limitations: The prepared panel has 19 liquid Binance perpetuals, whereas the source used a much broader cryptocurrency cross-section. Funding is not present in the OHLCV panel.
